entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-05-12
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • CS8509 reported for exhaustive switch expression over single-case union #83666
  • Rope.Equals uses slow IEnumerable<char> iterator for StringRope, adding unnecessary overhead to large string switch compilation #83663
  • Copilot/CCA errors out in roslyn repo #83658

Closed

  • Documentation block autocomplete breaks with existing untagged documentation comment content #82174

    Area-IDE

    Area-IDE, Area-Razor
